svg.title: Compact objects: two honest size scales
svg.desc: Two-panel comparison of compact-object radii: Earth and a white dwarf on a thousands-of-kilometers scale, then a zoomed panel comparing a neutron star and stellar-mass black-hole horizon on a tens-of-kilometers scale.
